note: Your holdings. Unlike watchlist.json (which the screener rebuilds every morning), this file is yours — nothing overwrites it. Every card here is priced daily regardless of its value or set, so a $900 grail is tracked just like a $20 chase. Discord alerts fire ONLY for these, on the same rule as the rest of the site: a flip to or from BUY/SELL. Easiest way to fill it: star cards on the site, click Export in the sidebar, and commit the file it hands you. Entries whose note begins with 'example' are ignored. `qty` and `paid` are optional and only affect the portfolio totals. VINTAGE CARDS: TCGdex has no pricing for a lot of pre-2023 cards. For those, use `vintageId` (TCG API's numeric card id) plus `vintageQuery` (a name that finds it via https://tcgapi.dev search) instead of `id` — priced from TCG API, real history backfilled once from their /history endpoint, but never scored (no BUY/SELL signal, no alerts) since the lifecycle model is fitted on cards under 3 years old and hasn't been tested against a decade-old print. Imported 2026-08-07 from PriceCharting collection (seller nrovud2ybtfivv4yxshkn26xee), every Pokemon card valued over $10 that resolved to a confident single-print match. `paid` unknown for these — PriceCharting's public view doesn't expose cost basis — left null; fill in if you want gain/loss tracked.
